question: Walk me through Stellar's protocol upgrade history from Protocol 19 through the latest version, with the headline feature of each.

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-14 Mainnet runs Protocol 29. P19 2022-06-08 preconditions; P20 2024-02-20 Soroban; P21 2024-06-18 secp256r1; P22 2024-12-05 BLS12-381; P23 Whisk 2025-09-03 parallel scheduling (CAP-0063) and live/archival state; P24 2025-10-22 archival-bug fix; P25 X-Ray 2026-01-22 BN254/Poseidon; P26 Yardstick 2026-05-06 SAC G-account balances, more BN254 and checked 256-bit math; P27 Zipper 2026-07-08 CAP-0071 auth delegation; P28 2026-09-16 CAP-0083/0085/0086; P29 2026-10-01 a security release with no new CAPs. Bell (P30) is on Testnet with its Mainnet vote scheduled for 2026-11-23.
keyFacts: Maps each of Protocols 19 to 29 to its headline feature.
States the live Mainnet protocol with an as-of date.
avoid: Do NOT mis-pair features and versions or call P26, P27 or P28 the latest after 2026-10-01.
golden.notes: Accept a later sourced Mainnet tail (for example Bell once activated).
